sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "color_key" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND name = trim(name)), CHECK (length(name_key) >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "color_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND name = trim(name)), CHECK (length(name_key) >= 1), CHECK (length(color_key) >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "freq" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (freq IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly')), CHECK (interval >= 1), CHECK (mode IN ('schedule', 'after_completion')), CHECK (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= anchor_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_series (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "deadline_date" TEXT NULL, "deadline_minute" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "estimate_min" INTEGER NULL, "actual_adjust_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), CHECK (notes IS NULL OR length(notes) <= 5000), CHECK (deadline_date IS NULL OR deadline_date >= start_date), CHECK (deadline_minute IS NULL OR (deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND deadline_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)), CHECK (status IN ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed')), CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'normal', 'high')), CHECK (estimate_min IS NULL OR estimate_min > 0), CHECK ((status = 'completed') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES labels (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recurrence_freq" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily', "recurrence_interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "weekdays_mask" INTEGER NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on" TEXT NULL, "is_paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_paused" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "reminder_offset_min" INTEGER NULL, "reminder_ignore_quiet" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reminder_ignore_quiet" IN (0, 1)), "generated_through" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (name IS NULL OR length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), CHECK (start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (end_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (start_minute != end_minute), CHECK (recurrence_freq IN ('daily')), CHECK (recurrence_interval >= 1), CHECK (weekdays_mask IS NULL OR weekdays_mask BETWEEN 1 AND 127), CHECK (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on), CHECK (reminder_offset_min IS NULL OR reminder_offset_min BETWEEN 0 AND 60), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 2000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES labels (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "category_override_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NULL, "tz_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "utc_offset_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routines (id), "occurrence_date" TEXT NULL, "planned_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES entries (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind IN ('planned', 'actual')), CHECK (source IN ('manual', 'routine', 'from_plan')), CHECK (start_utc % 60000 = 0), CHECK (end_utc IS NULL OR (end_utc % 60000 = 0 AND end_utc > start_utc AND end_utc <= start_utc + 604800000)), CHECK ((source = 'routine') = (routine_id IS NOT NULL AND occurrence_date IS NOT NULL AND kind = 'planned')), CHECK (source = 'routine' OR (routine_id IS NULL AND occurrence_date IS NULL)), CHECK (source != 'from_plan' OR kind = 'actual'), CHECK (planned_entry_id IS NULL OR (kind = 'actual' AND source = 'from_plan')), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 2000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exceptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_offset_min" INTEGER NULL, "end_offset_min" INTEGER NULL, "label_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES labels (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("routine_id", "occurrence_date"), CHECK (type IN ('skip', 'modify')), CHECK (start_offset_min IS NULL OR start_offset_min BETWEEN -720 AND 2880), CHECK (end_offset_min IS NULL OR end_offset_min BETWEEN -720 AND 2880), CHECK (start_offset_min IS NULL OR end_offset_min IS NULL OR end_offset_min > start_offset_min), CHECK (type = 'modify' OR (start_offset_min IS NULL AND end_offset_min IS NULL AND label_id IS NULL AND note IS NULL)), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 2000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "offset_days" INTEGER NULL, "minute_of_day" INTEGER NULL, "custom_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "ignore_quiet" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ignore_quiet" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (minute_of_day IS NULL OR minute_of_day BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK ((type = 'custom' AND custom_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND offset_days IS NULL) OR (type IN ('at_start', 'on_deadline') AND minute_of_day IS NOT NULL AND offset_days IS NULL AND custom_at_utc IS NULL) OR (type = 'before_deadline' AND offset_days IS NOT NULL AND offset_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND minute_of_day IS NOT NULL AND custom_at_utc IS NULL)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"), CHECK (scope IN ('portable', 'device')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_notifications" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "fire_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"), CHECK (platform_id BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647));
